title: Hoang Nguyen
description: The Emperor gets his, royally, as Anakin Skywalker returns to his Jedi roots. "It's a very dramatic moment in RETURN OF THE JEDI," observes Hoang Nguyen. "Vader forsakes the dark side, even though it costs him his life." Nguyen was born in Saigon, Vietnam, during the war and now resides in Virginia with his parents. His first professional job in the comics industry was the ROBOCOP Ill movie adaptation for Dark Horse. After contributing to DC's infamous Impact line, Nguyen found work at Marvel penciling ALIEN LEGION. He is currentiy the artist on thc PUNISHER WAR ZONE project and in the summer of '94 he will begin illustrating JUDGE DREDD for DC.
